description: A feature flag set to 10% in the payment service's `charge.js` caused the `charge` function to throw `Error("Payment request failed. Invalid token. …")` on ~10% of calls; the checkout service's `chargeCard` turned the gRPC error into `"could not charge the card"`, `PlaceOrder` returned gRPC `Internal`, and the frontend proxied it as HTTP 500 on `POST /api/checkout`.
mechanism:
The flag is read in [`charge.js#L29`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/payment/charge.js#L29): the payment service's `charge` function evaluates `getNumberValue("paymentFailure", 0)`, which returns `0.1` (variant `10%`). When the value is > 0, it generates a random number and fails the request if `Math.random() < 0.1` ([`charge.js#L33`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/payment/charge.js#L33)), giving a 10% failure rate.

On failure (lines 34-37), the span is annotated with `app.loyalty.level=gold` and the function throws `Error('Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold')`. The error propagates through the gRPC payment service to the checkout service's `chargeCard` at [`main.go#L552-L556`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L552), which returns `"could not charge the card: ..."`, and the checkout handler returns `codes.Internal` at [`main.go#L335`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L335), failing the order.

frontend.description: Clicking "Place Order" on the cart page intermittently returns an error (~10% of the time) — the user remains on the cart page and never reaches the order confirmation. No payment is charged, no items are shipped, and the cart is not emptied.
frontend.trigger_condition: User clicks "Place Order" on the cart page while paymentFailure is enabled. The payment service rejects the charge with 10% probability (`Math.random() < 0.1` in [`charge.js#L33`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/payment/charge.js#L33)).
frontend.call_pattern: Sequential call within PlaceOrder: [`main.go#L333`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L333) calls `cs.chargeCard(ctx, total, req.CreditCard)`, which calls `paymentService.Charge()` at [`main.go#L552`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L552). The charge fails before shipping or cart cleanup.
frontend.cause: The frontend API route [`checkout.ts#L18`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/pages/api/checkout.ts#L18) calls `CheckoutGateway.placeOrder`, which invokes the checkout service's `PlaceOrder` gRPC. `PlaceOrder` calls `cs.chargeCard` at [`main.go#L333`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L333), which calls `paymentService.Charge()` at [`main.go#L552`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L552). The payment service evaluates the paymentFailure flag at [`charge.js#L29`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/payment/charge.js#L29); when `Math.random() < 0.1` ([`charge.js#L33`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/payment/charge.js#L33)), it throws `Error('Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold')` at [`charge.js#L37`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/payment/charge.js#L37). The error is caught in [`index.js#L24`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/payment/index.js#L24) and returned via gRPC callback. `chargeCard` wraps it as `"could not charge the card"` ([`main.go#L556`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L556)), and `PlaceOrder` returns `codes.Internal` at [`main.go#L335`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/checkout/main.go#L335). The frontend surfaces the gRPC error as HTTP 500. In `CartDetail.tsx`, the `await placeOrder(...)` at [`CartDetail.tsx#L38`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/components/Cart/CartDetail.tsx#L38) rejects, so `push` to the confirmation page at [`CartDetail.tsx#L57`](../../opentelemetry-demo/src/frontend/components/Cart/CartDetail.tsx#L57) never executes.
